_about: Animal sign for the hunting trail and 'teeming wildlife' (Sal, 2026-10-31), data and hints only; read by nothing yet. Per species: `group` and `track` (the words a skilled tracker reads from prints) and `signs` = a kind of sign with its one-line hint (12 words or fewer, each says only what the sign is). Tracking levels come from data/items/tracking.json species_reading (40 tells the group, 65 names the species, 90 age and injury). Proposed use: the world places sign near where each species lives (deterministic from the cell hash, like ground scatter), and a hint shows when the player looks at it or passes within 3 m. Feathers and wool tufts already exist as items; droppings could become Manure (compost) later. Sign types are common to many species: droppings, tracks, burrow, den, feathers, rubbing, browse, gnawing.
